excerpts.anchor: TD is believed to be rare in developed, food-secure countries
marks: TD is believed to be rare in developed, food-secure countries, except in certain populations or medical situations. As a result of this perception, thiamine is not consistently assessed in healthcare practice or in the nutritional surveys that guide policy.
